name: capture-replay

protocol.note: Same-environment replay is cpu-reference serialize → deserialize → replay. capture_hash and ir_hash must be identical across two serializations of the same package. Fault captures replay with the recorded poison (PartiallyProduced / Poisoned) and fault taxonomy. A post-consume snapshot (Active, size>0, empty bytes) is refused with the exact string 'cannot restore a consumed representation'. vg-capture-view writes a markdown/json report of allocation id, generation, representation_epoch, size, and fault code/message; it must not emit GPU pointers or 0x device addresses. required_capabilities that the ReplayEnvironment does not have fail closed ('incompatible capabilities refused'). Metal↔Vulkan is semantic correspondence only (stable IDs, IR hash, epoch, fault taxonomy) and never claims both executed. Schema remains vg.capture/v1 with schema_version 2; view metadata is optional (ADR-040).

correctness.tolerance: exact (hash equality, poison/fault taxonomy, refuse strings). Raster image compare is out of this row; use existing raster oracles if a raster capture is later attached.

skipped_variants.reason: No second driver or OS upgrade laboratory is available on this host; the catalog marks the variant conditional.

judgement: A compute-exact capture round-trips on cpu-reference with stable capture_hash and ir_hash; fault poison is preserved; a consumed package is refused with the Phase C wording; incompatible capabilities are refused by name; vg-capture-view lists stable IDs without GPU addresses. Metal↔Vulkan is recorded as semantic correspondence, not dual execution. Dynamic-graph records discover_reachable seeds and the reachable subset (schema_version stays 2; empty packages still report blocked rather than inventing a graph from graph_references). driver-update remains skipped: no second-driver lab. No performance curve is claimed.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/035/040/041); Metal↔Vulkan is semantic mapping of stable IDs / IR hash / epoch / fault taxonomy and is never reported as both backends having executed
